company.name: Birch Biosciences
company.shortDescription: Birch Biosciences is a biotechnology research firm that specializes in recycling plastic using enzymes.
company.description: Birch Biosciences are used in the recycling process naturally and efficiently break down plastic. Unlike traditional recycling, the process produces virgin-quality, environmentally sustainable, and cost-competitive recycled outputs, enabling a truly circular plastics economy. The proprietary platform employs artificial intelligence, bioinformatics, and high-throughput screening techniques.
